title: French Pork Ribs Casserole
description: A hearty, comforting dish that is perfect for a cold winter night. The combination of tender pork ribs and velvety casserole is sure to satisfy.
instructions: Season the pork ribs with salt and black pepper.
In a large skillet, melt 1 tablespoon of butter over medium heat.
Add the garlic and cook until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add the pork ribs and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Transfer the pork ribs to a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Pour the velvety casserole over the pork ribs.
Sprinkle the shredded cheese and breadcrumbs over the casserole.
Dot the top with the remaining 1 tablespoon of butter.
Bake in the preheated oven for 25-30 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
